function ekoFilter(J){EKO.H=ekoHitMap();const q=nkey(EKO.q),ql=EKO.q.toLowerCase();const P=new Set(ekoPicks().map(p=>p.id));

 ({dir:ekoDir,cor:ekoCor,scr:ekoScr,pick:ekoPick,qa:ekoQa})[EKO.tab](B,J,b)}

const EKO_CSS=`.eko .ex-kpis{margin-bottom:10px}.eko-b{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:10px}
.eko-fb{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.eko-lc{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.eko-lc .sx-chip i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c)}.eko-lc .sx-chip.on{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--c);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 16%,transparent)}.eko-lc small{color:var(--faint)}
.eko-fr .sx-btn{flex:0 0 auto;width:auto;margin-top:0}.eko-fr{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:11px}.eko-fr select{height:28px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel-solid);color:var(--text);font:inherit;font-size:11px;padding:0 6px;max-width:200px}.eko-q{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:200px}.eko-q input{width:100%}.eko-ck{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.eko-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:start}@media (max-width:1180px){.eko-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.eko-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:68vh;overflow:auto}.eko-r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px}.eko-r:hover{background:var(--hover)}.eko-r.on{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.eko-r .t b{display:block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.eko-r .t small{display:block;color:var(--faint);font-size:10px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.eko-r .t small.cn{color:var(--muted)}.tg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;margin-top:4px}.tg .tm-s{font-size:9.5px;padding:0 6px}.tm-s.u{color:var(--muted)}
.eko-lb{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:26px;height:18px;border-radius:5px;font:600 9.5px Inter,Vazirmatn;color:var(--c);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 15%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 40%,transparent);margin-inline-end:4px}
.eko-pk.on,.eko-dc header .sx-btn.on{color:var(--good);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 50%,transparent)}
.eko-d{position:sticky;top:0}.eko-dc>header b{font-size:13px}.eko-cn{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:-4px 0 6px}.eko-dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 10px;font-size:11px;margin:10px 0}.eko-dl dt{color:var(--faint)}.eko-dl dd{margin:0;line-height:1.7}
.eko-ir{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px;margin:8px 0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}.eko-ir.on{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fwarn) 45%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fwarn) 6%,transparent)}.eko-ir>b{display:block;font-size:11.5px}.eko-ir span{color:var(--muted)}.eko-ir em{font-style:normal;color:var(--text)}.eko-ir p{margin:4px 0 0}.eko-tn{color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px}
.eko-x{margin:6px 0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.9}.eko-x summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.eko-x p{margin:4px 0;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word}
.eko-rf,.eko-src{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 8px;align-items:center;margin:8px 0;font-size:10.5px}.eko-rf>b,.eko-src>b{font-size:11px;width:100%}.eko-src a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:6px;padding:1px 6px}
.eko-id{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:none;color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;font:inherit;font-size:10.5px;padding:2px 7px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}.eko-id:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}.eko-lk{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin:4px 0}
.eko-act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:10px 0 6px}.eko-out:empty{display:none}.eko-out{margin-bottom:8px}
.eko-warn{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fwarn) 45%,transparent)}.eko-warn p{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}.eko-warn em{font-style:normal;color:var(--text)}
.eko-cl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:10px}.eko-c{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.85;animation:sxRise .45s both;animation-delay:var(--d)}.eko-c header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.eko-c b{display:block;margin:4px 0}.eko-c p{margin:4px 0;color:var(--muted)}.eko-c ul{margin:6px 0;padding-inline-start:16px;font-size:10.5px}.eko-c a{color:var(--accent)}
.eko-gw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:6px}.eko-gw button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:9px;background:none;color:var(--text);font:inherit;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;text-align:start}.eko-gw button:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}.eko-gw b{font-size:11.5px}.eko-gw span{font:600 15px Inter,Vazirmatn}.eko-gw small{color:var(--faint);font-size:10px}.eko-gw.sm span{font-size:12px}
.eko-h5{margin:12px 0 6px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600}.eko-mini{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;max-height:220px;overflow:auto}
.eko-sh{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,.6fr) minmax(0,1.4fr);gap:10px;align-items:start;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px}.eko-sh>div>small{display:block;color:var(--faint)}.eko-hl small{color:var(--faint);margin-inline-start:6px}.eko-ir.sn{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fbad) 50%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fbad) 7%,transparent)}.eko-hl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.eko-hl em{font-style:normal;color:var(--fbad)}

const fa2=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[۰-۹]/g,d=>'۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)).replace(/[٠-٩]/g,d=>'٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d)).replace(/[٬،]/g,',').replace(/٫/g,'.');
/* history = server-accumulated + manual entries (manual wins on the same day) */
function mkHist(){const C=mkC()||{hist:{}};const H={};Object.entries(C.hist||{}).forEach(([k,a])=>H[k]=a.map(x=>[x[0],+x[1]]));
 mkM().manual.forEach(m=>{const k=m.s+'|'+m.l;const a=H[k]=H[k]||[];const i=a.findIndex(x=>x[0]===m.d);if(i>=0)a[i]=[m.d,+m.v];else a.push([m.d,+m.v])});Object.values(H).forEach(a=>a.sort((x,y)=>x[0]<y[0]?-1:1));return H}
const mkLast=(H,k)=>{const a=H[k];return a&&a.length?a[a.length-1]:null};
function mkAt(H,k,d){const a=H[k];if(!a||!a.length||!d)return null;let best=null;for(const p of a){if(p[0]<=d)best=p;else break}if(best&&fwDiff(best[0],d)<=21)return best;const f=a.find(p=>p[0]>d);return f&&fwDiff(d,f[0])<=10?f:null}
const mkName=k=>MKL[k]||((MKSER[k.split('|')[0]]||k.split('|')[0])+' '+k.split('|')[1].replace(/_/g,' '));

 asia:/busan|korea|japan|tokyo|yokohama|singapore|port klang|kaohsiung|ho chi minh|haiphong|laem chabang|کره|ژاپن|سنگاپور|بوسان/i,
 ir:/bandar ?abbas|shahid ?rajaee|rajaee|bnd\b|bushehr|chabahar|imam khomeini|bik\b|khorramshahr|asaluyeh|iran|بندرعباس|بندر عباس|شهید رجایی|رجایی|بوشهر|چابهار|امام خمینی|خرمشهر|عسلویه|ایران/i,
 gulf:/jebel ?ali|dubai|sharjah|khalifa|abu dhabi|dammam|hamad|doha|sohar|kuwait|umm qasr|basra|jeddah|aqaba|جبل ?علی|دبی|شارجه|ابوظبی|دمام|دوحه|صحار|کویت|ام‌?القصر|بصره|جده/i,

 med:/genoa|genova|piraeus|valencia|barcelona|mersin|istanbul|ambarli|izmit|gemlik|novorossiysk|constanta|koper|trieste|la spezia|جنوا|پیرئوس|مرسین|استانبول|نووروسیسک/i,

function mkMap(r){if(r&&r.mode==='rail'){const H=mkHist();return (MKRX.cn.test(String(r.pol||''))||MKRX.cn.test(String(r.pod||'')))&&H['manual|ERAI']?['manual|ERAI']:[]}if(!r||!['sea','multi'].includes(r.mode||'sea'))return [];const o=String(r.pol||''),d=String(r.pod||'');const fromCn=MKRX.cn.test(o)||MKRX.asia.test(o);if(!fromCn)return MKRX.cn.test(d)?[]:['fbx|FBX'];
 if(MKRX.ir.test(d)||MKRX.gulf.test(d))return ['ccfi|PERSIAN_GULF_RED_SEA','scfi|COMPREHENSIVE_INDEX','ccfi|COMPOSITE_INDEX'];if(MKRX.neu.test(d))return ['fbx|FBX11','wci|ROTTERDAM','ccfi|EUROPE'];if(MKRX.med.test(d))return ['fbx|FBX13','wci|GENOA','ccfi|MEDITERRANEAN'];
 if(MKRX.usw.test(d))return ['fbx|FBX01','wci|LOS_ANGELES','ccfi|W_C_AMERICA'];if(MKRX.use.test(d))return ['fbx|FBX03','wci|NEW_YORK','ccfi|E_C_AMERICA'];return ['ccfi|COMPOSITE_INDEX','scfi|COMPREHENSIVE_INDEX']}
const mkRefD=r=>r.from||(r.t?new Date(r.t).toISOString().slice(0,10):null)||fwToday();
/* index-adjusted value of an actual rate as of `to` (default: latest index) */
function mkAdj(r,H=mkHist(),to){const u=pU(r.amt,r.cur);for(const k of mkMap(r)){const a=mkAt(H,k,mkRefD(r));const b=to?mkAt(H,k,to):mkLast(H,k);if(a&&b&&a[1]>0){const ratio=b[1]/a[1];return {usd:u*ratio,ratio,k,d0:a[0],v0:a[1],d1:b[0],v1:b[1],base:u}}}return null}
/* unified lane key: mode | origin | destination | equipment class */
const mkEqC=e=>{e=String(e||'').toUpperCase().replace(/\s/g,'');if(/^40|FEU|HC|HQ/.test(e))return /RF|RH/.test(e)?'40RF':'40';if(/^20|TEU/.test(e))return /RF/.test(e)?'20RF':'20';return e||'?'};
const mkPk=s=>nkey(String(s||'').replace(/\(.*?\)|port|بندر|,.*$/gi,'')).slice(0,18);
const mkLane=r=>[r.mode||'sea',mkPk(r.pol),mkPk(r.pod),mkEqC(r.eq)].join('|');
const MKSRC={rfq:['استعلام آنلاین',85],email:['ایمیل/متن',70],excel:['فایل Excel',70],csv:['فایل CSV',70],manual:['ثبت دستی',65],seed:['مرجع کریدور',40],index:['برآورد شاخص',35]};
const mkSrcOf=r=>r.src||(/مرجع کریدور/.test(r.note||'')?'seed':'manual');
const mkMed=a=>{if(!a.length)return null;const s=[...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=s.length>>1;return s.length%2?s[m]:(s[m-1]+s[m])/2};
/* credibility (0-100) + verdict for every rate in one pass */
function mkScore(R=rbAll(),H=mkHist()){const t=fwToday();const L={};const V=R.map(r=>{const a=mkAdj(r,H);const u=pU(r.amt,r.cur);const now=a?a.usd:u;const o={r,u,now,adj:a,lane:mkLane(r)};(L[o.lane]=L[o.lane]||[]).push(o);return o});
 V.forEach(o=>{const r=o.r;const peers=L[o.lane].filter(x=>x!==o&&rbStat(x.r,t)!=='exp');const ref=mkMed(peers.map(x=>x.now));o.ref=ref;o.n=peers.length;
  const age=Math.max(0,fwDiff(mkRefD(r),t));const fr=age<=7?100:age<=30?80:age<=60?55:age<=90?35:15;const exp=rbStat(r,t)==='exp';
  const st=(MKSRC[mkSrcOf(r)]||MKSRC.manual)[1]*(r.conf!=null?(.6+.4*r.conf):1);const near=peers.filter(x=>Math.abs(x.now/o.now-1)<=.15).length;const cor=!peers.length?50:near>=2?100:near===1?75:30;
  o.dv=ref?(o.now/ref-1):null;const ds=o.dv==null?60:Math.abs(o.dv)<=.1?100:Math.abs(o.dv)<=.2?75:Math.abs(o.dv)<=.35?45:15;
  o.score=Math.round((st*.3+fr*.3+cor*.2+ds*.2)*(exp?.6:1));o.cl=o.score>=75?'ok':o.score>=50?'warn':'bad';
  o.verdict=o.dv==null?'':o.dv>.15?'exp':o.dv<-.2?'cheap':'fair'});return V}
const MKV={exp:['گران‌تر از بازار','bad'],cheap:['ارزان مشکوک','warn'],fair:['منصفانه','ok'],'':['بدون مرجع','']};
const mkVb=v=>`<span class="tm-s ${MKV[v||''][1]}">${MKV[v||''][0]}</span>`;
const mkCb=o=>`<span class="mk-cr ${o.cl}" title="منبع، تازگی، تأیید متقابل و فاصله از میانهٔ بازار"><i><s style="width:${o.score}%"></s></i><b>${fa(o.score)}</b></span>`;
/* RFQ quote verdict: other quotes on the route (index-adjusted to today) + system model */
function mkQuote(q,Q,model){const H=mkHist();const k='ccfi|COMPOSITE_INDEX';const last=mkLast(H,k);const adj=x=>{const d=new Date(x.t||Date.now()).toISOString().slice(0,10);const a=mkAt(H,k,d);return a&&last?x.c*last[1]/a[1]:x.c};
 const refs=Q.filter(x=>x!==q).map(adj);if(model>0)refs.push(model);const ref=mkMed(refs);if(!ref)return {v:'',dv:null};const dv=q.c/ref-1;return {v:dv>.15?'exp':dv<-.2?'cheap':'fair',dv,ref,n:refs.length}}
/* ---------- auto-ingest: e-mail / free text / CSV / Excel ---------- */
const MKCUR=[[/US\$|USD|\$|دلار/i,'USD'],[/EUR|€|یورو/i,'EUR'],[/AED|درهم/i,'AED'],[/CNY|RMB|¥|یوان/i,'CNY'],[/TRY|₺|لیر/i,'TRY'],[/RUB|₽|روبل/i,'RUB'],[/IRR|ریال/i,'IRR']];
const mkCur=s=>{for(const [re,c] of MKCUR)if(re.test(s))return c;return ''};
const MKEQ=/\b(20|40|45)\s*['’`]?\s*(GP|DV|DC|HC|HQ|RF|RH|OT|FR|ST|STD)?\b|\b(FEU|TEU)\b/gi;
const mkEqN=(n,t)=>{if(!n)return t==='FEU'?'40DV':'TEU';t=(t||'').toUpperCase();return n==='20'?(t==='RF'?'20RF':'20DV'):n==='45'?'40HC':t==='HC'||t==='HQ'?'40HC':t==='RF'||t==='RH'?'40RF':'40DV'};
const MKMON={jan:1,feb:2,mar:3,apr:4,may:5,jun:6,jul:7,aug:8,sep:9,oct:10,nov:11,dec:12};
function mkDate(s){s=fa2(s).trim();let m;if(typeof s==='number'||/^\d{5}$/.test(s)){const n=+s;if(n>30000&&n<70000)return new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+n*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10)}
 if((m=s.match(/(20\d\d)[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})/)))return mkIso(+m[1],+m[2],+m[3]);if((m=s.match(/(1[34]\d\d)[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})/))){try{return mkJal(+m[1],+m[2],+m[3])}catch(e){}}
 if((m=s.match(/(\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](20\d\d)/)))return mkIso(+m[3],+m[2],+m[1]);
 if((m=s.match(/(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?[\s-]*([A-Za-z]{3})[a-z]*[\s,-]*(20\d\d)?/))&&MKMON[m[2].toLowerCase()]){const y=+m[3]||new Date().getFullYear();return mkIso(y,MKMON[m[2].toLowerCase()],+m[1])}
 if((m=s.match(/([A-Za-z]{3})[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?,?\s*(20\d\d)?/))&&MKMON[m[1].toLowerCase()]){const y=+m[3]||new Date().getFullYear();return mkIso(y,MKMON[m[1].toLowerCase()],+m[2])}return ''}
const mkIso=(y,m,d)=>{const x=new Date(Date.UTC(y,m-1,d));return isNaN(x)||m>12||d>31?'':x.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
function mkJal(jy,jm,jd){jy+=1595;let days=-355668+365*jy+Math.floor(jy/33)*8+Math.floor((jy%33+3)/4)+jd+(jm<7?(jm-1)*31:(jm-7)*30+186);let gy=400*Math.floor(days/146097);days%=146097;if(days>36524){gy+=100*Math.floor(--days/36524);days%=36524;if(days>=365)days++}gy+=4*Math.floor(days/1461);days%=1461;if(days>365){gy+=Math.floor((days-1)/365);days=(days-1)%365}
 const sal=[0,31,(gy%4===0&&gy%100!==0)||gy%400===0?29:28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31];let gm=1;for(;gm<13&&days>=sal[gm];gm++)days-=sal[gm];return mkIso(gy,gm,days+1)}
const MKPORT=/(shanghai|ningbo|qingdao|shenzhen|yantian|shekou|guangzhou|nansha|tianjin|xingang|xiamen|dalian|hong ?kong|busan|singapore|bandar ?abbas|shahid ?rajaee|bushehr|chabahar|imam khomeini|jebel ?ali|dubai|sharjah|mersin|istanbul|rotterdam|hamburg|genoa|novorossiysk|umm qasr|karachi|nhava sheva|mundra|شانگهای|نینگبو|چینگدائو|شنژن|گوانگژو|تیانجین|بندرعباس|بندر عباس|شهید رجایی|بوشهر|چابهار|امام خمینی|جبل ?علی|دبی|مرسین|استانبول)/i;
function mkIncl(s){s=String(s);const inc=[];if(/all[\s-]?in/i.test(s))inc.push('all-in');if(/BAF|bunker/i.test(s))inc.push(/BAF[^.\n]{0,20}(incl|included|شامل)/i.test(s)?'BAF شامل':'BAF جدا');if(/THC/i.test(s))inc.push(/THC[^.\n]{0,20}(incl|included|شامل)/i.test(s)?'THC شامل':'THC جدا');if(/subject to|excl/i.test(s))inc.push('هزینه‌های جانبی جدا');return inc.join('، ')}
function mkMode(s){return /rail|train|wagon|ریلی|قطار|واگن/i.test(s)?'rail':/truck|road|FTL|LTL|کامیون|جاده/i.test(s)?'road':/air|AWB|kg\b|هوایی/i.test(s)?'air':'sea'}
/* header-based tables (CSV/Excel/TSV) */
const MKH={pol:/^(pol|origin|from|load|loading|port of loading|مبدأ|مبدا|بارگیری)/i,pod:/^(pod|dest|destination|to|discharge|port of discharge|مقصد|تخلیه)/i,eq:/^(eq|equip|equipment|container|cntr|type|size|تجهیز|کانتینر|نوع)/i,amt:/^(amt|amount|rate|price|o\/f|ocean ?freight|freight|all ?in|مبلغ|نرخ|قیمت|کرایه)/i,cur:/^(cur|currency|ارز)/i,
 to:/^(valid|validity|valid to|valid till|expiry|exp|to date|اعتبار|معتبر تا)/i,from:/^(valid from|from date|effective|شروع)/i,vendor:/^(vendor|carrier|line|agent|forwarder|supplier|company|شرکت|خط|حمل|تأمین)/i,tt:/^(tt|transit|t\/t|ترانزیت)/i,mode:/^(mode|شیوه)/i,note:/^(note|remark|توضیح)/i};
function mkTable(rows,src){if(!rows||rows.length<2)return null;let hi=-1,map=null;for(let i=0;i<Math.min(rows.length,8);i++){const M={},eqc=[];rows[i].forEach((c,j)=>{const s=fa2(c).trim();if(!s)return;const em=s.match(/^(20|40|45)\s*['’]?\s*(GP|DV|DC|HC|HQ|RF|ST)?$/i);if(em){eqc.push([j,mkEqN(em[1],em[2])]);return}for(const [k,re] of Object.entries(MKH))if(M[k]==null&&re.test(s)){M[k]=j;break}});
  if((M.pol!=null||M.pod!=null)&&(M.amt!=null||eqc.length)){hi=i;map={M,eqc};break}}if(!map)return null;const {M,eqc}=map;const out=[];const g=(r,k)=>M[k]!=null?fa2(r[M[k]]).trim():'';
 rows.slice(hi+1).forEach(r=>{if(!r||!r.some(x=>String(x).trim()))return;const pol=g(r,'pol'),pod=g(r,'pod');if(!pol&&!pod)return;const cur=mkCur(g(r,'cur'))||mkCur(g(r,'amt'))||'USD';const to=mkDate(r[M.to]!=null?r[M.to]:'');const from=mkDate(r[M.from]!=null?r[M.from]:'')||fwToday();
  const base={mode:RMODE[g(r,'mode')]?g(r,'mode'):mkMode(g(r,'eq')+' '+g(r,'note')),vendor:g(r,'vendor'),pol,pod,cur,from,to,tt:fwN(g(r,'tt'))||null,note:g(r,'note'),incl:mkIncl(g(r,'note')+' '+g(r,'amt')),src};
  const push=(eq,amt)=>{const a=+String(amt).replace(/[^\d.]/g,'');if(a>0)out.push({...base,eq,amt:a,conf:(pol&&pod?.5:.2)+(to?.25:0)+(base.vendor?.25:0)})};
  if(eqc.length)eqc.forEach(([j,eq])=>push(eq,fa2(r[j])));else push(M.eq!=null?(()=>{const s=g(r,'eq').toUpperCase();const m=s.match(/(20|40|45)\s*['’]?\s*(GP|DV|DC|HC|HQ|RF)?/);return m?mkEqN(m[1],m[2]):REQ.includes(s)?s:s||'40DV'})():'40DV',g(r,'amt'))});return out}

/* pair money amounts with the nearest container size on one line */
function mkAmts(L0){const L=L0.replace(/\d{4}[-/.]\d{1,2}[-/.]\d{1,2}|\d{1,2}[-/.]\d{1,2}[-/.]\d{4}/g,x=>' '.repeat(x.length));const E=[],A=[];let m;const er=/\b(20|40|45)\s*['’`]?\s*(GP|DV|DC|HC|HQ|RF|RH|OT|FR|ST|STD|NOR)?(?!\d)(?![.,]\d)(?!\s*(?:days?|روز|%|kg|ton|t\b))|\b(FEU|TEU)\b/gi;
 while((m=er.exec(L)))E.push({s:m.index,e:m.index+m[0].length,eq:m[3]?(m[3].toUpperCase()==='FEU'?'40DV':'TEU'):mkEqN(m[1],m[2])});
 const ar=/(US\$|USD|\$|EUR|€|AED|CNY|RMB|¥)?\s?(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d{2,6})(\.\d+)?\s?(USD|EUR|AED|CNY|RMB|\$|دلار)?/gi;const lc=mkCur(L);
 while((m=ar.exec(L))){const s0=m.index+(m[0].length-m[0].trimStart().length),e0=m.index+m[0].trimEnd().length;if(E.some(x=>s0<x.e&&e0>x.s))continue;const n=+m[2].replace(/,/g,'');const cur=mkCur((m[1]||'')+(m[4]||''));
  const after=L.slice(e0,e0+16);if(/^\s*(?:days?|روز|%|kg|cbm|ton)/i.test(after))continue;if(!cur&&!lc)continue;if(!cur&&n>=1990&&n<=2100)continue;if(n<50||n>200000)continue;A.push({s:s0,e:e0,n,cur:cur||lc||'USD',after})}
 const used=new Set();return A.map(a=>{let eq=null;const pv0=E.filter(x=>x.e<=a.s&&a.s-x.e<=14&&!used.has(x)&&/^[\s:=@\-–]*(?:US\$|USD|\$|EUR|€|AED|CNY|RMB)?[\s:=]*$/i.test(L.slice(x.e,a.s))).pop();const nx=pv0?null:E.find(x=>x.s>=a.e&&x.s-a.e<=10&&/^\s*(?:\/|per|for|each|\bx\b)/i.test(L.slice(a.e,x.s)));if(pv0)eq=pv0;else if(nx)eq=nx;else{const pv=E.filter(x=>x.e<=a.s&&a.s-x.e<=40&&!used.has(x)).pop();if(pv)eq=pv}if(eq)used.add(eq);return {eq:eq?eq.eq:'40DV',amt:a.n,cur:a.cur,sure:!!eq}})}
/* free text / e-mail */
function mkText(t,src='email'){t=fa2(t).replace(/\r/g,'');const out=[];const G={to:'',vendor:'',from:''};
 const vm=t.match(/valid(?:ity)?\s*(?:till|until|thru|through|to|up to|:)?\s*([^\n;]{4,24})|(?:اعتبار|معتبر)\s*(?:تا|:)\s*([^\n;]{4,24})/i);if(vm)G.to=mkDate(vm[1]||vm[2]);
 const cm=t.match(/(?:carrier|line|vessel operator|شرکت کشتیرانی|خط)\s*[:：]\s*([^\n,;]{2,40})|\bvia\s+(MSC|Maersk|CMA[\s-]?CGM|COSCO|OOCL|Evergreen|ONE|HMM|Hapag[\s-]?Lloyd|ZIM|Yang ?Ming|PIL|Emirates Shipping|IRISL|Wan Hai|KMTC|SITC)\b/i);if(cm)G.vendor=(cm[1]||cm[2]).trim();
 const fm=t.match(/^(?:from|sender|از)\s*:\s*(.+)$/im);const sender=fm?fm[1].replace(/<.*?>/,'').trim().slice(0,40):'';let route=null;
 const lines=t.split(/\n|(?<=\.)\s+(?=[A-Z])/);for(const ln of lines){const L=ln.trim();if(!L)continue;
  const rm=L.match(new RegExp(MKPORT.source+'(?:\\s*(?:port|,?\\s*china|,?\\s*uae|,?\\s*iran))?\\s*(?:-+|–|—|to|→|->|>|/|تا|به)\\s*'+MKPORT.source,'i'));if(rm)route={pol:rm[1].replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase()),pod:rm[2].replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase())};
  if(!route)continue;const lineTo=(()=>{const m=L.match(/valid[^\d\n]{0,12}([^\n;]{4,24})|اعتبار[^\d\n]{0,8}([^\n;]{4,24})/i);return m?mkDate(m[1]||m[2]):''})();
  const amts=mkAmts(L);
  amts.forEach(a=>out.push({mode:mkMode(L),vendor:G.vendor||sender,pol:route.pol,pod:route.pod,eq:a.eq,amt:a.amt,cur:a.cur,from:fwToday(),to:lineTo||G.to,tt:(()=>{const x=L.match(/(?:t\/t|transit|ترانزیت)\D{0,10}(\d{1,3})/i);return x?+x[1]:null})(),note:L.slice(0,120),incl:mkIncl(L),src,conf:.45+(lineTo||G.to?.25:0)+(G.vendor||sender?.15:0)+(a.sure?.15:0)}))}
 const seen=new Set();return out.filter(r=>{const k=[r.pol,r.pod,r.eq,r.amt].join('|');if(seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true})}
function mkParse(input,src){if(Array.isArray(input))return mkTable(input,src||'excel')||[];const t=String(input||'');const first=t.split(/\r?\n/).find(x=>x.trim())||'';
 if(/[,;\t]/.test(first)&&first.split(/[,;\t]/).length>=3){try{const T=mkTable(readCsv(t),src||'csv');if(T&&T.length)return T}catch(e){}}return mkText(t,src||'email')}
/* ---------- server pull + jump alerts ---------- */
let MKBUSY=null;async function mkPull(force){const u=svUrl();if(!u)return null;if(MKBUSY)return MKBUSY;MKBUSY=(async()=>{try{const j=force&&svOn()?await svApi('/api/live/indices/refresh',{method:'POST'}):await fetch(u+'/api/live/indices?days=400',{cache:'no-cache'}).then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.json()});
  if(!j||!j.series)throw new Error('پاسخ نامعتبر');LSS('ifa-mkt-cache',{...j,got:Date.now()});const M=mkM();const fresh=(j.alerts||[]).filter(a=>a.t>(M.seen||0));if(fresh.length){M.seen=Math.max(...fresh.map(a=>a.t));mkMS(M);
   fresh.slice(0,3).forEach(a=>{toast(`⚠ جهش شاخص ${MKSER[a.s]||a.s} — ${a.n}: ${a.chg>0?'+':''}${nf(a.chg,1)}٪`);emit('rate.jump',{index:a.s,line:a.k,name:a.n,value:a.v,change:a.chg})})}
  emit('market.updated',{series:Object.keys(j.series).length,t:j.t});mkWatchRun();return j}catch(e){MKS.err=e.message;return null}finally{MKBUSY=null}})();return MKBUSY}

/* ---------- charts ---------- */
function mkSpark(a,w=120,h=30){if(!a||a.length<2)return `<svg class="mk-sp" width="${w}" height="${h}"></svg>`;const v=a.map(x=>x[1]),lo=Math.min(...v),hi=Math.max(...v),r=hi-lo||1;const P=v.map((y,i)=>[(i/(v.length-1))*(w-4)+2,h-3-(y-lo)/r*(h-6)]);const up=v[v.length-1]>=v[0];
 return `<svg class="mk-sp ${up?'up':'dn'}" width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}"><path d="M${P.map(p=>p.map(n=>n.toFixed(1)).join(',')).join('L')}"/><circle cx="${P[P.length-1][0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${P[P.length-1][1].toFixed(1)}" r="2.2"/></svg>`}
function mkChart(a,unit){if(!a||a.length<2)return '<div class="sx-muted mk-ce">برای نمودار دست‌کم دو نقطهٔ تاریخی لازم است — سرور تاریخچه را هر هفته انباشته می‌کند؛ مقادیر گذشته را می‌توانید دستی هم وارد کنید.</div>';
 const W=760,Hh=220,pl=54,pr=12,pt=12,pb=26;const v=a.map(x=>x[1]),lo=Math.min(...v)*.97,hi=Math.max(...v)*1.03,r=hi-lo||1;const t0=Date.parse(a[0][0]),t1=Date.parse(a[a.length-1][0]),tr=t1-t0||1;
 const X=d=>pl+(Date.parse(d)-t0)/tr*(W-pl-pr),Y=y=>pt+(1-(y-lo)/r)*(Hh-pt-pb);const P=a.map(p=>[X(p[0]),Y(p[1])]);const ticks=[0,.25,.5,.75,1].map(f=>lo+f*r);
 return `<svg class="mk-ch" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${Hh}" preserveAspectRatio="none">${ticks.map(y=>`<line x1="${pl}" x2="${W-pr}" y1="${Y(y)}" y2="${Y(y)}"/><text x="${pl-6}" y="${Y(y)+3}" text-anchor="end">${nf(y)}</text>`).join('')}
  <path class="a" d="M${P[0][0]},${Hh-pb}L${P.map(p=>p.join(',')).join('L')}L${P[P.length-1][0]},${Hh-pb}Z"/><path class="l" d="M${P.map(p=>p.map(n=>n.toFixed(1)).join(',')).join('L')}"/>
  ${a.length<=60?P.map((p,i)=>`<circle cx="${p[0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${p[1].toFixed(1)}" r="2.4"><title>${jdt(a[i][0])}: ${nf(a[i][1],1)} ${unit||''}</title></circle>`).join(''):''}
  <text x="${pl}" y="${Hh-8}">${jdt(a[0][0])}</text><text x="${W-pr}" y="${Hh-8}" text-anchor="end">${jdt(a[a.length-1][0])}</text></svg>`}
